# obsalt

Self-hosted call analytics and quality for live AI voice agents.
Core ships no providers. Memory stores are test doubles, not a backend.
There is no SQLite mode. There is no require_auth=false.

## Do not invent

- A waterfall from unplaced durations (Vapi/Retell chips, not bars)
- Decode on the webhook request path
- A second storage backend
- org_id chosen from a payload field or OTLP attribute
- Missing Tier-2 judge output as a passing eval
- HeuristicJudge scoring an English rubric (those stay not_judged)
- A Faithfulness Pass/Fail table from regex. Cheap path is detector/2 flags.
- Provider fields that are not in the vendored schema
- A private POST-us-a-JSON-snapshot SDK. Custom agents emit OTLP.

## Data flow (ASCII)

Hosted platform --signed webhook--> ingest
Your agent     --OTLP traces------> ingest
ingest: write blob -> Postgres inbox/outbox -> 2xx ack
worker: decode -> redact -> assemble -> ClickHouse revision -> CAS Postgres pointer
console: read pointer, then that revision

## Vocabulary to keep

CallRevision, NormalizedEvent, StageMeasurement, AggregateMeasurement,
SignalCoverage, FidelityDeclaration, RawEnvelope, TimelineFidelity,
MeasurementPlacement, PipelineArchitecture, Provenance, org_id, ingest_key.
